comment: nexo.infra (section 11, D118-D121): what each portable resource is on each target. Read by both phases (nexo/stdlib/infra.py and compiler/runtime/src/infra.rs). Templates: ${path} takes a value; a string that is only ${path} keeps its type; {"$if": path, "then": t, "else": t} and {"$each": path, "do": t} (in lists, with ${item...}).

cost.comment: Estimated EUR per month (on-demand list prices, rounded). An app is per replica at its cpu and ram.

sla.comment: Published monthly availability of each service, in percent; the estimate multiplies those of the resources an app needs.

areas.comment: The area of a region, for data_region (section 23, rule 3).
